description: This file defines a class 'RelationalStorage' that provides general-purpose database access functionality using ADO.NET, including methods for executing queries and commands asynchronously, handling cancellation, and intercepting commands. It is part of a namespace that varies based on compilation symbols, related to Orleans framework storage components.

classes.name: RelationalStorage
classes.description: A class providing asynchronous database operations for relational databases using ADO.NET, supporting command execution, query reading, and command interception.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of RelationalStorage with specified invariant name and connection string.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Executes a SELECT query asynchronously and processes the results with a provided selector function.

methods.name: ExecuteAsync
methods.description: Executes a non-query SQL command asynchronously, returning the number of affected rows.
